page.overview:
What is Armament Haki?

Color of Armament Haki, or simply Armament Haki, is a form of Haki that allows the user to use their own spiritual energy to create, in essence, an invisible piece of armor around themself, providing incredible offensive and defensive capabilities.

Notably, this form of Haki can be used to injure Devil Fruit users that are otherwise immune to ordinary physical attacks, such as Logia users. Gol D. Roger described it as "a power that doesn't yield to the Devil Fruits".

In Wano Country, Armament Haki is known as , founded on the concept of inner flow.

Armament Haki was first shown by Sentomaru using the advanced application of emission to hit Luffy and harm his rubber body without making physical contact with him, which made the Straw Hat Pirates think he was a Devil Fruit user due to their lack of knowledge about the ability. Afterwards, Rayleigh used Haki to stop Kizaru and was also able to hurt him despite his Logia body.
